messages:
Marta: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing segment  I had two product questions that came up in my team: 1) when exactly do dev sandbox credits reset (time-of-day/UTC?), and 2) what's the supported path for CI/test exemptions so infra teams can run scale tests without manual finance approvals?

Leah (CEO): Good call, Marta. Short answer: sandbox credits reset at 00:00 UTC on the 1st of the month. For exemptions we currently do manual approvals but we're planning a self-serve flow for org admins.

Sana (Finance): Adding detail  standard free/dev sandboxes get a fixed monthly allocation and there's no automatic rollover today. For enterprise contracts we can provision rollover or buffer credits in the SOW. Large long-running exemptions (> 2M tokens/month) still need a finance/security check.

Riley (Platform): For Dedicated customers the model is: reserved capacity + per-cluster burst pool. If traffic exceeds reserved we pull from burst; if burst exhausted requests are rate-limited. We emit route-level metrics so customers can see reserved_vs_burst.

Jamal (SRE): Clarifying Q: Is the burst pool global or per-customer? And is the exemption for CI going to be a header we can attach to requests or an account-level flag? Would prefer a header for ephemeral runs.

Riley (Platform): Burst pool is global to a cluster but we enforce per-customer soft caps to prevent noisy neighbors. Planned exemption UX: org-admin toggle + short-lived tokens; we're also prototyping a request-header ("X-Redwood-Test-Exempt") for ephemeral CI tokens that still appear in audit logs. Example runtime policy: 

```
exemption_policy:
  type: short_lived_token
  max_duration_minutes: 180
  audit: true
  token_header: X-Redwood-Test-Exempt
```

Sana (Finance): Important: any self-serve exemptions will have guardrails. Short-lived test tokens under 100k tokens/day will be auto-approved; anything larger will go through a lightweight workflow (manager approval + auto-expiry). We'll publish exact thresholds once implemented.

Marta: That helps. For the rollover pilot Leah mentioned during the all-hands  who is eligible and when will we open it?

Leah (CEO): Rollover pilot will be limited to a small set of developer-heavy orgs in Q3. Product will contact shortlisted customers. Internally we'll offer an opt-in flag for orgs in the Console.

Jamal (SRE): Action item: if we get a header-based exemption, we need to ensure pathing still honors per-route SLOs and that the KV cache/quotas accounting doesn't bypass billing events. I'll open a ticket to validate the metrics pipeline.

OpsBot: Note: pricing docs PR linked https://redwood.internal/docs/pricing-exemptions  updated draft exists. (bot)

Riley (Platform): Also note we plan to surface an "exemptions" tab in the Console with history + audit trails + remaining allowance. This is H2 work.

Sana (Finance): One more on credits: we will provide a CSV export of monthly credit usage for org owners so teams can reconcile with billing.

Marta: Thanks everyone. I'll collect follow-ups and open a GH issue for the exemption header work + Console flag. @Riley @Jamal @Sana please add technical acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

Leah (CEO): Thanks, Marta. We'll track in the product board.

Riley (Platform): Ack.
